existing_infrastructure.reuse: loadFixture/mock tracker, seedRepo, runSkill/scriptedDriver and decision-assert already exercise REAL eligible/next commands and record bucket/mutation attempts in disposable repo. Scenarios include ready promotion and stale parks.
existing_infrastructure.proof_limit: Scripted driver mutations/buckets are plumbing proof, not model action judgement. Frozen tracker model records attempts and does not itself prove hosted writes.

existing_infrastructure.reuse: Complete deterministic pure predicate/realCLI boundary table; including in-progress protect/strip/surface. No reason to rebuild this decision table in a new adapter.
Real CLI/pure strict-TTL, negative clock and invalid-source cases. Fixed --now and explicit TTL avoid ambient clock.

Existing capture-driver and skill wiring assertions cover retained best-effort decide/action integration. Reuse relevant source guard checks only after a draft changes those lines, not broad unrelated suites.

Already demonstrates real park-history computation and safe recorded demote/tag action pattern; useful existing fixture technique if a later batch touches repeat-park. Not needed for this chosen earlier housekeeping range.
Existing model-backed judgement driver and skill harness can measure backlog classification rubric.
existing_infrastructure.proof_limit: It is not a ready full autonomous housekeeping executor; it does not prove actual model obeys mutation authority for this chosen batch. Do not relabel existing classification or scripted-driver output as that proof.

irreducible_source_facts_and_judgement: Tracker freshness and comments/spec discovery remain mandatory; canonicalise only a genuinely discovered spec, never a description.
Eligibility authority differs from mechanical housekeeping: not-eligible skips prep tagging/promotion but may receive bounded nonpipeline housekeeping while retaining eligibility.

Recognising human curation, classifying a park comment, matching same closed spec topic and determining later human takeover remain source-based judgement/observation. Pure verdict tests cannot establish that supplied facts are true.
Archive/cancel vocabulary and obvious-orphan exceptions must be preserved exactly; do not broaden permitted mutation through a generic safe-housekeeping label.
existing_ambiguities_to_preserve_and_dis: Current claim paragraph says git-only tracker writes no-op but ref release still runs; its trailing paragraph says git-only no reclaim path. A compression cannot silently pick one as a new policy. Preserve this as a separate source inconsistency for root adjudication if this exact branch enters the candidate.

The final Never in autonomous mode ban on label/grouping changes is broad while earlier bullets define bounded exceptions. Preserve those explicit exceptions; do not erase them by referring only to the broad ban.
Shared autonomous.md Tidy summary row is narrower/stale. Current explicit Tidy contract, not that row alone, supplies local action authority.
cost_effective_next_step: Root may draft this12.8KB coherent batch with a small authority/action table and refer-backs, then perform bounded source review and only affected existing source-wiring/CLI tests. No new bespoke harness is required for that draft/deterministic integration. If accepted model fidelity is desired, existing generic tracker/CLI record seams are reusable, but a truthful new registered model action workload is still needed; no fully ready workflow proof was found and no framework should be built merely to justify every sentence.
